functions: stopAtWall (b4): stops when no obstacle is ahead, calls followLine when one is
followLine (b10): curves left on black, curves right on the floor
control_flow: stopAtWall: if the obstacle sensor ahead sees nothing, stop; otherwise call followLine.
followLine: if the line tracker sees black, curve left; otherwise curve right.
